dictionary.title: Voice Manager & Voice Identity
dictionary.description: Configure how Nuxiva speaks: choose between on-device neural models, ElevenLabs (including free tier with credit tracking) and audio vault.
dictionary.order_hint: Nuxiva uses the first available voice in the list; the others are fallbacks.
dictionary.order_empty: No voices listed: Nuxiva chooses on its own
dictionary.strategy_selector_hint: Switch between 100% offline neural models or hyper-realistic ElevenLabs with smart fallback.
dictionary.engine_local_desc: Kokoro & Piper. Zero cloud egress, zero cost, works completely offline.
dictionary.engine_elevenlabs_desc: Maximum vocal expressiveness. Supports Free plan (10k char/month) or paid tiers.
dictionary.engine_hybrid_desc: Uses ElevenLabs while credits last, automatically falls back to local models if quota expires.
dictionary.elevenlabs_panel_desc: Manage API Key, monitor monthly character usage and pick your desired voice.
dictionary.key_stored_securely: Key is stored securely in your local environment file.
dictionary.get_free_key_link: Get a free API key (10,000 char/month free) on elevenlabs.io
dictionary.test_text_placeholder: Type a phrase to make Nuxiva speak...
dictionary.speak_to_room_hint: Plays audio directly on the physical speakers connected to Nuxiva server
dictionary.pregenerate_hint: Instantly generates 14 standard greetings and smart home confirmations
dictionary.clear_vault_hint: Deletes dynamic clips while keeping pinned ones
dictionary.no_clips_in_vault: No audio clips in vault yet. Talk to Nuxiva or click 'Pre-generate Common Phrases'!
